claim: Causally published U.S. oil drilling activity acceleration can identify periods when oilfield services outperform broad energy after switching costs.

source.series: sum Rig Count Value where Country=UNITED STATES and DrillFor=Oil by US_PublishDate
source.availability: first U.S. trading session strictly after US_PublishDate; Baker Hughes states North America count is published Friday at noon Central
source.history_contract: stitch the fixed Aug-29-2025 archive through its terminal publish date with the fixed Sep-04-2026 current workbook only for later dates; exact-overlap revision audit must be reported before any support claim

signal.rule: ON when current U.S. oil rig count is strictly greater than the count 13 published weekly observations earlier; otherwise OFF
signal.hold: until the next causally available weekly publication

controls.matched_static: static OIH/XLE mix using full-sample mean ON exposure

evaluation.pass_gate: full matched_excess_cagr > 0 AND full xle_excess_cagr > 0 AND at least 3 of 4 folds have matched_excess_cagr > 0 AND overlap_revision_mismatch_rate <= 0.01
